newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus reverse repo yield steady at 4.44 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus reverse repo yield steady at 4.44 pct.

text.p: The average yield on a reverse repo auction of 8-day Cyprus bills by the central bank to commercial banks was 4.44 percent on Monday, unchanged from the yield at the previous auction on July 29.
Commercial banks submitted bids worth 25 million pounds ($46.25 million) for repo bills on offer worth 20 million pounds by the central bank.
The central bank accepted bids for bills worth 20 million pounds.
The highest accepted yield was 4.50 percent and the lowest accepted yield was 4.40 percent, the central bank said. ($=0.54 Cyprus pounds)
